'use client';
​
import {Stack} from '@astryxdesign/core/Layout';
import {Card} from '@astryxdesign/core/Card';
import {Button} from '@astryxdesign/core/Button';
import {Text} from '@astryxdesign/core/Text';
import {useToast} from '@astryxdesign/core/Toast';
​
export default function StackAlignment() {
  const showToast = useToast();
  return (
    <Stack direction="vertical" gap={3} width="100%" style={{maxWidth: 500}}>
      <Card padding={4}>
        <Stack direction="vertical" gap={4}>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Start (left)
          </Text>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" gap={1} hAlign="start">
            <Button
              label="Cancel"
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() =>
                showToast({body: 'Demo: your edits would be discarded here'})
              }
            />
            <Button
              label="Save"
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() =>
                showToast({body: 'Demo: your changes would be saved here'})
              }
            />
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
      <Card padding={4}>
        <Stack direction="vertical" gap={4}>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            Center
          </Text>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" gap={1} hAlign="center">
            <Button
              label="Cancel"
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() =>
                showToast({body: 'Demo: your edits would be discarded here'})
              }
            />
            <Button
              label="Save"
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() =>
                showToast({body: 'Demo: your changes would be saved here'})
              }
            />
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
      <Card padding={4}>
        <Stack direction="vertical" gap={4}>
          <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
            End (right)
          </Text>
          <Stack direction="horizontal" gap={1} hAlign="end">
            <Button
              label="Cancel"
              variant="secondary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() =>
                showToast({body: 'Demo: your edits would be discarded here'})
              }
            />
            <Button
              label="Save"
              variant="primary"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() =>
                showToast({body: 'Demo: your changes would be saved here'})
              }
            />
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
    </Stack>
  );
}
